ciReport.rc8_scope: Exact same captured UIWindow is preserved; only the current root actually owned by that window may travel back. No old root is reinstalled. Schema2/channelv2 distinguishes legitimate root replacement from old root-mismatch refusal. Bounded handoff retention/polling and all exact-profile/owner/lock/target gates remain. Actual return remains a phone gate.
ciReport.rc7_scope: Exact-profile Messenger-only public UIKit companion conditionally returns only the same original UIWindow/root from an exact PPO-prefix disconnected session to its still-connected original scene. No screenshots, focus/key-window request or direct FBScene mutation. Bounded state telemetry via libnotify. Trial refuses missing/stale companion readiness. Actual public session-name mapping, migration and restored pixels require the phone.
ciReport.rc6_scope: Exact installed Messenger585.0.0/build1101076820 plist SHA256 profile only, unknown/eligible=false proof with explicit warm-trial admission. Unique normal existing foreground source/layers required, no cold fallback; same verified owned-child API, automatic15s close,8s render deadline, no Keep/resize/minimize.
